title: cokmi buxa tibba hayte numma
intro: Palaas addal angodda elle sugteeh, reeda absolute luk sugteeh, dudda le taama abeynit gaaboyna qammalsime wayta gexkalootuk foocal soolisse. namma gititte dirab kee numma boodak sugte wak silayti qammalsimak baqitte. Dagom gaaboowe mari yaaxige too angaaraw ken mano milaagele amotani kee etch ken aydaadu diini kutbeh.
clues: Nanu soonoonaanih duddal yimixxigeh sugneeh, gexkalit foocal hayneh caylale mirac gaaboyseh sugne.
too uddur yemeete wak, nanu ninni silaacitte qidneeh, xaloot qammalla, ninni gabâ taamal kibal luk.
takkay immay nanu nublem ninni yahaadal hununuh onkorritte ceelaah, ni sorkoco baxi digga sinni numma yaaxige.
Nanu sujuud baaxol radne, Muusa kee Aaron Rabbih imaan diggosne, amoyti naqabu luk sugne way.
too amoyti nee meysiseh kaxxam qangiinoh digaalah, xagana neh korosul nee yargiqem kee ni gabaay saduh tan gititte.
Nanu raqneh sugne, nanu ninni Rabbih cokmi doornam faxe baadal tan taqabitte, kee nanu ninni diinih shahiid abne.

arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
